requirements.statement: Personal-first with near-term multi-user commercialization; preserve tenant and deployment foundations from the start.
requirements.acceptance: Same core runs a private account and hosted tenants without converting global financial state into user state.

requirements.statement: Primary purpose is portfolio-aware decisions plus frequent trading signals.
requirements.acceptance: A decision identifies its goal/account impact; frequent scans do not bypass suitability.

requirements.statement: A useful no-paid-market-data baseline must not require paid AI; hosting and optional providers are separate.
requirements.acceptance: Rules-only onboarding and a qualified decision workflow complete with zero paid data and zero AI calls.

requirements.statement: Mandatory discovery is US-listed stocks and ETFs with currency-aware accounts.
requirements.acceptance: US instrument identity and CAD/USD accounting work; outside-scope holdings remain visible.

requirements.statement: First release proposes specific actions but never submits, modifies or cancels broker orders.
requirements.acceptance: Broker mutation routes/tools are absent and attempted mutations are blocked at connector boundaries.

requirements.statement: Both hosted and complete self-hosted editions are release requirements.
requirements.acceptance: Both deployment profiles pass core journeys and isolation checks.

requirements.statement: Initial commercial audience includes Canadian and US residents.
requirements.acceptance: Jurisdiction inventory and counsel-approved capability matrix cover intended launch customers in both countries.

requirements.statement: Intraday swing discovery plus optional same-day opportunities; no sub-minute scalping requirement.
requirements.acceptance: Qualified regular-session strategy can produce timely proposals under its data/model configuration.

requirements.statement: Frequent evaluation means timely qualifying changes, not a quota of trades.
requirements.acceptance: A no-opportunity session records zero proposals and explicit rejection reasons without manufactured trades.

requirements.statement: Separate investing and trading allocations with portfolio-wide limits.
requirements.acceptance: A trading proposal cannot spend a long-term reserve and combined exposure is checked.

requirements.statement: Free mode may require a user-connected free provider account/key.
requirements.acceptance: Setup discloses provider account, limits and rights; key connection alone does not mark capabilities qualified.

requirements.statement: Stale or unreconciled holdings/cash block affected portfolio-specific sizing.
requirements.acceptance: A stale account yields research or hypothetical output, not confirmed buying-power sizing.

requirements.statement: Independent open-source core and complete self-hosted application; no mandatory vendor-operated service.
requirements.acceptance: Disconnect vendor services and exercise permitted core workflows with user-selected dependencies.

requirements.statement: Prioritized live monitoring plus broader scheduled discovery; tracked and streamed universes differ.
requirements.acceptance: Exceeding live-symbol quota produces visible prioritization, not fictitious continuous coverage.

requirements.statement: Auditable rules and AI research both originate proposals; a separate agent evaluates actionable AI-mode proposals.
requirements.acceptance: An AI-only thesis can qualify without a technical trigger, but cannot bypass hard checks.

requirements.statement: MCQs and necessary numeric/date inputs propose a policy/strategy shortlist for explicit runtime approval.
requirements.acceptance: Contradictory objectives require resolution and no policy is active merely from inferred answers.

requirements.statement: Opt-in first-release options include long calls/puts, covered calls, cash-secured puts and defined-risk verticals.
requirements.acceptance: All permitted structures have scenarios and checks; out-of-scope imported contracts remain represented.

requirements.statement: API and subscription access use provider-specific officially permitted routes and deployment qualification.
requirements.acceptance: No session-token interception/proxy; unavailable subscription routes are reported, not emulated.

requirements.statement: Mandatory evidence/calculation verification is tiered; separate model review is required for AI-mode actions.
requirements.acceptance: Factual alerts can pass without LLMs; pending AI review cannot be relabelled as reviewed.

requirements.statement: Action proposals expire and have invalidation conditions plus preserved version history.
requirements.acceptance: Late notifications resolve to current state; corrected decisions do not overwrite original results.

requirements.statement: Commercial legal and provider-rights clearance are release gates.
requirements.acceptance: Documentation access and disclaimers do not mark rights/regulatory gates passed.

requirements.statement: Apache-2.0 is the selected application license, superseding AGPL proposals.
requirements.acceptance: License and dependency inventory reflect Apache choice without bundling incompatible material by assumption.

requirements.statement: Support audited rules-only and AI-enabled modes; evaluator covers both proposal origins in AI mode.
requirements.acceptance: Switching modes is explicit; rule outputs are not falsely labelled AI-reviewed.

requirements.statement: AI proposals qualify through evaluated research workflows and proposal-specific checks, not necessarily a backtested rule.
requirements.acceptance: Workflow status/version is recorded and model changes do not silently inherit evidence.

requirements.statement: Evaluator is a separate run/context; a different model family is optional and empirically justified.
requirements.acceptance: Configuration reports same-model isolation versus cross-model diversity accurately.

requirements.statement: Material factual/evidence conflicts and hard risk failures block; forecast differences may be disclosed; revisions bounded.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewer disagreement cannot be bypassed by repeated sampling until an approval appears.

requirements.statement: Frequent deterministic monitoring; AI on meaningful events/schedules/requests within budgets and deadlines.
requirements.acceptance: Unchanged evidence is reused lawfully; quota exhaustion cannot remove mandatory review.

requirements.statement: All six improvement targets are in scope, including code and the optimizer itself.
requirements.acceptance: Each target has a candidate/evaluation/review/promotion/rollback path.

requirements.statement: Promotion uses predeclared scorecards with hard risk/privacy/evidence constraints, not recent returns alone.
requirements.acceptance: A candidate with higher simulated P&L but a hard violation is rejected.

requirements.statement: Autonomous authorized experiments, human-controlled promotion of investment-affecting or code changes.
requirements.acceptance: A model cannot self-approve its deployment or widen permissions.

requirements.statement: Private learning per user/installation by default; cross-user use requires separate consent and permitted data.
requirements.acceptance: Another tenant cannot access or learn from private examples absent authorized transformation/consent.

requirements.statement: Separate experiment resource budgets; current monitoring and verification take priority.
requirements.acceptance: Experiment exhaustion pauses experiments while essential services remain available.

requirements.statement: All six improvement areas, code-level change and recursive optimizer change must work at first release.
requirements.acceptance: Full release cannot pass by labelling code/recursive paths future work or disabling them.

requirements.statement: Material changes to enabled investment strategies require user adoption after release approval.
requirements.acceptance: Maintainer approval does not silently change an existing user's strategy semantics.

requirements.statement: Personal pilot incremental inference ceiling USD100/month; improvement maximum 20 percent (USD20).
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent reservations cannot exceed either cap; unrelated subscription/hosting expenses are separately shown.

requirements.statement: Single-machine container self-hosting without required Kubernetes/GPU/vendor service.
requirements.acceptance: Clean supported installation, backup restore and core workflows complete on qualified hardware.

requirements.statement: Demonstrate V0 optimizer proposing V1, independent evaluation, human promotion, then V1 running next cycle.
requirements.acceptance: Lineage and actual version receipts prove changed implementation was used, including rejected controls.

requirements.statement: Generated code is isolated from production secrets, DB writes, unrestricted network and host control.
requirements.acceptance: Sandbox escape/secret/egress tests fail closed with no weaker silent fallback.

requirements.statement: User learning is tenant-scoped; shared executable/optimizer changes are installation/release scoped.
requirements.acceptance: Hosted user cannot deploy a private executable fork into shared production.

requirements.statement: Open evaluation framework and permitted starter corpus; distinguish synthetic/historical/prospective evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Starter demonstrations never count as live trading evidence or personal learned history.

requirements.statement: Full scope and release gates take precedence over launch date; budget limits throughput rather than silently cutting scope.
requirements.acceptance: Required capabilities actually complete representative workloads within qualified resource constraints.

requirements.statement: Partial portfolios allowed with scoped conclusions; outside-coverage assets retained with gaps.
requirements.acceptance: Unknown outside exposure is not zero; full-financial-situation claims are withheld.

requirements.statement: Multiple accounts/currencies with account-specific spendability and consolidated risk.
requirements.acceptance: Cash in another account/currency cannot fund a proposal without an explicit prerequisite.

requirements.statement: Stock/ETF proposals cash-funded long-only, nonleveraged/noninverse; approved options remain.
requirements.acceptance: Short/leveraged discovery cannot become a new action; existing such positions still contribute known exposure.

requirements.statement: Primary and permitted independent sources; optional social inputs clearly distinguished from facts.
requirements.acceptance: An unverified social claim is a research lead, not corroborated evidence.

requirements.statement: Tax-relevant records and warnings, not a comprehensive tax engine or automated tax-loss harvesting.
requirements.acceptance: P&L/cost basis provenance is shown without presenting it as definitive tax liability.

requirements.statement: Responsive web, in-app feed, configurable email/browser push; no native mobile/SMS launch requirement.
requirements.acceptance: Expiry-aware notifications work and self-hosting needs no proprietary notification server.

requirements.statement: Small named set of tested read-only broker sync routes; CSV/manual fallback.
requirements.acceptance: Each connector passes fields, pagination, reconnect and reconciliation tests, not only login.

requirements.statement: Proposals form jointly feasible sets with explicit alternatives and internal capital commitments.
requirements.acceptance: Two USD4000 proposals cannot jointly consume USD5000; unexecuted sales do not create cash.

requirements.statement: Initial actionable intraday proposals are regular-session only; research may run outside session.
requirements.acceptance: Premarket event can create conditional research but must be refreshed before activation.

requirements.statement: Hosted/self-hosted migration is supported at first release.
requirements.acceptance: Compatible financial/policy/private-learning state transfers; credentials and executable imports do not activate silently.

requirements.statement: Tamper-evident retained history, not indefinite private retention; explicit correction/deletion/backups.
requirements.acceptance: Deleted evidence makes replay limitations visible and restoration reapplies tombstones.

requirements.statement: CIBC import, Questrade/IBKR read-only sync, plus Wealthsimple sync and Yahoo CSV interoperability.
requirements.acceptance: Named commitments each have deployment-specific qualification evidence; no silent downgrade to generic CSV.

requirements.statement: Reference scale: 10 accounts, 250 instruments, 100000 records/user; hosted 100 users and 20 concurrent sessions.
requirements.acceptance: Combined workload tests retain background monitoring for all users and distinguish provider stream limits.

requirements.statement: Managed service pricing plus user-connected providers; independent self-hosted core and unbiased rankings.
requirements.acceptance: Billing/affiliate data cannot influence security rankings; cancelling hosting supports lawful export.

requirements.statement: Dashboard-led portfolio/decision/research/governance workspaces; chat uses same verified state.
requirements.acceptance: Chat cannot emit an actionable recommendation outside the governed proposal pipeline.

requirements.statement: Yahoo tested CSV portfolio/watchlist import and compatible export; no auto-sync/data-adapter launch promise.
requirements.acceptance: Round-trip differences are shown and Yahoo watchlists never imply owned shares.

requirements.statement: Underlying accounts and data sources are separate; reconcile overlapping views without duplication.
requirements.acceptance: A broker position mirrored in Yahoo totals once; two real accounts remain distinct.

requirements.statement: All six versioned stock/ETF strategy families required; qualification status separate from catalogue inclusion.
requirements.acceptance: Each family has documented logic/evaluation; failed variants remain research-only without edge claims.

requirements.statement: Conservative liquidity/spread/data/status-screened universe; optional speculative research cannot bypass gates.
requirements.acceptance: OTC/penny/failed checks excluded from default actionable discovery while existing exposure remains tracked.

requirements.statement: Bounded versioned strategy configuration, not unrestricted hosted arbitrary-code or visual strategy builder.
requirements.acceptance: Configuration changes enter relevant validation/adoption; developer code extension remains controlled.

requirements.statement: Free baseline supports portfolio-specific rebalancing plus a qualified non-intraday long-only strategy.
requirements.acceptance: End-to-end free positive and abstention journeys pass, not only dashboards/alerts.

requirements.statement: User-facing application-managed virtual portfolios and optional approved-policy shadow tracking.
requirements.acceptance: Simulation never changes real cash and clearly labels fills, costs, assumptions and unsupported cases.

requirements.statement: Versioned goal-appropriate/cash-flow-matched benchmarks and separate actual/simulated/recommendation scorecards.
requirements.acceptance: No fabricated historical cash flows; TWR/MWR calculated only with sufficient inputs.

requirements.statement: Separate operational qualification, investment evidence and user eligibility; family-specific actionable-use gates.
requirements.acceptance: Limited investment evidence allowed only under predeclared human-approved policy, never an ad-hoc exception.

requirements.statement: Versioned feed specifications and qualified continuity/reinitialization for provider changes.
requirements.acceptance: A mid-session IEX/SIP change cannot continue the old range silently; recovered signals are retrospective.

requirements.statement: Targets: 95 percent factual events within 5s of receipt; rules-only within 15s; AI intraday deadline at most 60s or earlier expiry.
requirements.acceptance: Independent event-age and remaining-window checks; misses count, retries cannot reset trigger, delivery measured separately.

requirements.statement: Explicit approved numerical account/allocation/concentration/planned-loss/scenario limits for sizing.
requirements.acceptance: Denominators and currencies displayed; missing mandatory limits block sizing; stops are not loss guarantees.

requirements.statement: Scoped loss/drawdown triggers pause new risk; monitoring and checked risk reduction continue; controlled resumption.
requirements.acceptance: Deposits cannot erase breaches; material resume needs reconciled state and explicit acknowledgement.

requirements.statement: Typed Python core, TypeScript/React, PostgreSQL, analytical file/object storage and durable jobs; three authority paths.
requirements.acceptance: Live, experiment and release operations share contracts but cannot share unrestricted authority.

requirements.statement: Reconciled decimal journal with explicit effective/publication/receipt/decision times; one calculation contract.
requirements.acceptance: Source corrections update current reconstruction without rewriting historical knowledge.

requirements.statement: Interpretable six-family starting implementations; 6-month/200-day momentum and 15-minute ORB are unqualified research defaults.
requirements.acceptance: Parameter choices are labelled candidates and cannot auto-enable live strategies.

requirements.statement: Capability/rights/degraded-state registry; provider/entitlement changes require reassessment.
requirements.acceptance: Connected status does not imply qualified; tenant feed sharing requires rights and consent.

requirements.statement: Persisted bounded workflows, explicit model/runtime versions, no silent paid/provider fallback.
requirements.acceptance: One evaluation plus at most one permitted revision; deadline/claim checks rerun on change.

requirements.statement: Read-only operation allowlists, secrets outside agents, tenant isolation including nonowner/nonbypass DB roles.
requirements.acceptance: Cross-tenant, RLS-bypass, tool mutation and secret-exfiltration tests block release.

requirements.statement: gVisor initial Linux sandbox qualification target; full recursive scope; reviewed signed promotion and compatible rollback.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported sandbox cannot qualify full release by dropping mandatory improvement paths.

requirements.statement: Hosted targets 99.9 percent availability, 15-minute RPO and 4-hour RTO; receipts not guarantees.
requirements.acceptance: Recovery and combined-budget tests demonstrate targets while external/end-to-end failures stay visible.

requirements.statement: End-to-end release journeys cover free mode, overlap, AI, intraday, options, risk pause, simulation, improvement, migration and isolation.
requirements.acceptance: All required journeys tied to versioned execution evidence, including negatives and failure recovery.

requirements.statement: Separate design choices from factual provider/legal/security/performance/economic gates.
requirements.acceptance: No completion claim without versioned evidence and no silent scope reduction when a gate fails.

requirements.statement: All API monetary amounts/quantities use decimal strings; times use UTC with exchange calendar identity.
requirements.acceptance: Schema rejects binary numeric money and timestamps without offsets.

requirements.statement: Immutable source observations map into balanced postings or quarantined exceptions; provisional views never double-post.
requirements.acceptance: Journal balance, idempotency, correction reversal and lot/cash reconciliation fixtures pass.

requirements.statement: Final publication atomically binds policy, account and proposal-set revisions to a checked cash commitment.
requirements.acceptance: A competing account update causes re-evaluation, never time-of-check/time-of-use overspend.

requirements.statement: Separate price, fundamental, calendar, broker and FX freshness policies; record event age and ingestion delay.
requirements.acceptance: Fast processing of five-minute-old broker state never labels it real-time confirmed.

requirements.statement: Track all experiments, point-in-time universe membership, delistings, corporate actions, costs and test access.
requirements.acceptance: A future filing, present-day survivor list or repeated final-holdout feedback cannot qualify a strategy.

requirements.statement: Expose structured audit rationale and evidence, not require inaccessible private model chain of thought.
requirements.acceptance: A reviewer can validate claim/calc provenance without requesting hidden model reasoning.

requirements.statement: Freshness/eligibility/policy/legal/release controls are enforced outside LLM contexts.
requirements.acceptance: Prompt injection asking to remove checks cannot change the final validator outcome.

requirements.statement: Evidence-derived state is deleted or invalidated under policy; archive import is not arbitrary execution.
requirements.acceptance: Malicious archive paths, symlinks, oversized extraction and executable payloads are rejected.

requirements.statement: At-least-once delivery uses idempotent consumers, bounded leases/retries and dead-letter recovery.
requirements.acceptance: Worker crash after database commit does not duplicate holdings or send duplicate actionable alerts.

requirements.statement: Option contract deliverables, adjusted multipliers, exercise style and settlement are explicit, not defaulted blindly.
requirements.acceptance: Nonstandard/unknown contracts remain represented but unsupported sizing/payoffs are blocked.

requirements.statement: No-unique-root MWR, nonpositive equity and missing valuation intervals return explicit unavailable status.
requirements.acceptance: Return fixtures identify ambiguity rather than invent a percentage.

requirements.statement: Exchange sessions include holidays, DST, early closes, auctions and halts in versioned calendars.
requirements.acceptance: ORB and expiry deadlines are session-derived rather than fixed UTC strings.

requirements.statement: Public/community code and skill inputs are reviewed; the optimizer cannot replace protected gates or signing keys.
requirements.acceptance: Mutation of evaluator answer keys, final thresholds or human authorization fails integrity checks.

requirements.statement: Keyboard-accessible financial tables and text states accompany colors; screen freshness is continuously visible.
requirements.acceptance: Keyboard-only and screen-reader journeys cover policy, reconciliation and proposal expiry.

requirements.statement: All external-provider feature claims are dated and distinguish docs, permission, auth and workload evidence.
requirements.acceptance: A docs-only record cannot become commercial-qualified without required receipts.

requirements.statement: Provider use permission includes financial-advice policy, allowed tools, retention and training settings.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported financial-use route is blocked even when OAuth or inference works.

requirements.statement: Self-hosted proof uses operator-controlled backup keys and no embedded universal service credentials.
requirements.acceptance: Install and restore work without project-vendor account or secret bootstrap call.

requirements.statement: Repository branding and production domain remain owner-configurable; no invented identity is normative.
requirements.acceptance: Brand replacement changes metadata only, not contracts or workflow semantics.

requirements.statement: A simulated fill must occur after modeled submission and under a declared available-data convention.
requirements.acceptance: Same-bar ambiguity resolves conservatively or as indeterminate, never automatically best-case.

requirements.statement: Runtime approvals are typed by maintainer release, operator install and user strategy adoption; planning delegation is not runtime consent.
requirements.acceptance: A conversational yes cannot satisfy a production promotion or investment-policy signature.
